slides.headline: AI GIVES GENERIC ANSWERS UNTIL YOU SHARE YOUR CONTEXT, CHECK ITS WORK, AND FEED IT REAL DATA
slides.kicker: AND THE EXACT WORDS THAT FIX THEM

slides.headline: 1) STOP ASKING WITHOUT TELLING IT WHO YOU ARE
slides.body: AI gives the same answer to a CEO and a student. 'I run a 12-person marketing agency. Before you answer, ask me 5 questions about my situation'

slides.headline: 2) STOP ACCEPTING THE FIRST ANSWER
slides.body: AI gives you one path and you take it. The better answers were right behind it. 'Give me 3 completely different approaches to this, then compare the trade-offs'

slides.headline: 3) STOP TRUSTING EVERYTHING IT SAYS
slides.body: AI sounds confident even when it's wrong. Make it check its own work. 'Critique your own answer. What did you get wrong or oversimplify? Fix it'

slides.headline: 4) STOP ASKING AI TO THINK SMALL
slides.body: Most people ask for a paragraph. Ask for the whole thing. 'Build me a complete 90-day marketing plan for my bakery's delivery launch with exact dates, channels, and budget'

slides.headline: 5) STOP HIDING YOUR REAL NUMBERS
slides.body: Asking 'how do I cut costs' without your actual expenses is just guessing. 'Here are my business expenses for 3 months [paste them]. Find the three growing fastest and tell me what to cut'

slides.headline: 6) STOP ONLY ASKING WHAT YOU ALREADY KNOW
slides.body: The best use of AI is finding your blind spots. 'Based on everything I told you, what am I not thinking about? What question should I be asking?'

slides.headline: SAVE THIS FOR YOUR NEXT AI CHAT
slides.body: Copy any of these into your next conversation and notice the difference. Daily AI skills and news you'll actually use

caption:
Swipe to see the 6 mistakes killing your AI results, and the copy-paste phrases that fix each one 🔑

Not telling AI who you are so every answer is generic, accepting the first answer without pushing for more, trusting everything it says without making it check itself, thinking small when AI can build you entire plans, hiding your real numbers instead of feeding them in, and never asking what you're missing.

The gap between someone who prompts AI well and someone who doesn't is getting wider every month. These 6 fixes are the difference between an answer you ignore and one you act on tonight.
